Title: Azure Search indexer for Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
With the Azure Search indexer for Azure Cosmos DB, you can integrate Azure Cosmos DB with Azure Search without having to write any code to maintain the indexing infrastructure. If you have an Azure Search account, you can simply call the Azure Search REST API to create a data source and an indexer for that data source. To learn more about the Azure Search indexer for Azure Cosmos DB:

  • Review the tutorial: Connecting Azure Cosmos DB with Azure Search using indexers
  • Read the blog announcement: Searching for text with Azure Cosmos DB

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
